title: fix(components): an expanded offcanvas sidebar is drawn inside the viewport (objectui#11464)
body:
Fixes #11464

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

The Shadcn `Sidebar` in its `offcanvas` form (the default) drew its **expanded** panel one sidebar-width past the edge it is anchored to, out of the viewport. It also reserved no width beside the page, and its rail took the collapsed styling. Expanded and collapsed drew the same thing, so a user could not tell the two states apart.

**Root cause.** Upstream blanks `data-collapsible` while the sidebar is expanded, so its `group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:` rules can only match a collapsed sidebar. objectui's copy keeps the attribute in every state (local edit (3) in `packages/components/shadcn-components.json`). The `icon` rules were qualified with `group-data-[state=collapsed]:` to match, and the offcanvas rules were not.

**Fix: one declared patch family, `sidebarOffcanvasStateQualifierPatches`, in `scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`.** It has one anchored edit per upstream line, and each one qualifies its line by the collapsed state:

| patch id | line (quoted from the registry bytes) |
|---|---|
| `sidebar-offcanvas-gap-collapsed-only` | the gap: `group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:w-0` |
| `sidebar-offcanvas-left-offset-collapsed-only` | `left-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:left-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)]` |
| `sidebar-offcanvas-right-offset-collapsed-only` | `right-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:right-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)]` |
| `sidebar-offcanvas-rail-collapsed-only` | the rail: `translate-x-0`, `after:left-full`, `hover:bg-sidebar` |
| `sidebar-offcanvas-rail-left-edge-collapsed-only` | `[[data-side=left][data-collapsible=offcanvas]_&]:-right-2` |
| `sidebar-offcanvas-rail-right-edge-collapsed-only` | `[[data-side=right][data-collapsible=offcanvas]_&]:-left-2` |

- The `group-data-*` rules take the `group-data-[state=collapsed]:` prefix the `icon` rules already carry. The two arbitrary-selector rail rules take `[data-state=collapsed]` inside the selector, the spelling the rail's collapsed cursor rules beside them already use.
- Every `find` was written from `scripts/__tests__/fixtures/shadcn-registry/sidebar.registry.txt`. All 10 sidebar anchors apply to the registry bytes (the offline round-trip test).
- Every `marker` is the **whole** patched string, so `verifyLocalPatches` requires the shipped file to carry the payload byte for byte. The shipped `src/ui/sidebar.tsx` change was written by `applyLocalPatches` itself, not by hand.
- On upstream bytes, where the attribute is blank while expanded, every qualifier is redundant, so the patched registry file draws exactly what upstream draws.
- `shadcn-components.json`'s edit (3) note no longer claims "same result". It now says which rules are qualified by hand (`icon`), and which by the declared family (`offcanvas`).
- A changeset, `@object-ui/components` patch.

## Geometry: BASE `6007dd4e4` vs this branch

Instrument: Chromium (the pre-installed `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, driven by the repo's Playwright 1.62.1) at 1280x800. The markup comes from the real components, server-rendered from source by Vite: the primitive, the SDUI `sidebar` node's renderer, and `SidebarNav`. The CSS is real Tailwind 4.3.3, compiled for exactly the classes that markup carries. x ranges are in px.

| case | BASE panel x | after panel x | BASE gap / page left | after gap / page left |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| offcanvas, left, **expanded** | -256 to 0 (off-screen) | 0 to 256 | 0 / 0 | 256 / 256 |
| offcanvas, right, **expanded** | 1280 to 1536 (off-screen) | 1024 to 1280 | 0 / page 0 to 1280 | 256 / page 0 to 1024 |
| offcanvas, left, collapsed | -256 to 0 | -256 to 0 (unchanged) | 0 / 0 | 0 / 0 |
| offcanvas, right, collapsed | 1280 to 1536 | 1280 to 1536 (unchanged) | 0 | 0 |
| icon, left, expanded (control) | 0 to 256 | 0 to 256 | 256 / 256 | 256 / 256 |
| icon, left, collapsed (control) | 0 to 48 | 0 to 48 | 48 / 48 | 48 / 48 |
| `sidebar` node, `collapsible` omitted, bare host | -256 to 0 | 0 to 256 | 0 | 256 |
| `SidebarNav collapsible="offcanvas"`, expanded | -256 to 0 | 0 to 256 | 0 / 0 | 256 / 256 |
| `SidebarNav collapsible="offcanvas"`, collapsed | -256 to 0 | -256 to 0 (unchanged) | 0 / 0 | 0 / 0 |

The rail, offcanvas, left, expanded: at BASE it had `translate` 0px, `right` -8px and `::after` `left` 16px, the collapsed styling. After the fix it has `translate` -50%, `right` -16px and `::after` `left` 8px, identical to the expanded `icon` rail. After the fix, every expanded offcanvas reading equals the expanded icon reading on both sides.

## The pin: `e2e/sidebar-offcanvas-geometry.spec.ts`

Option (a), a real engine, for three reasons:

- jsdom and happy-dom have no layout, and the triage pins are positions ("inside / outside the viewport").
- The repo already runs a geometry spec in the same lane: `e2e/record-header-title-width.spec.ts`, which uses `page.setContent` plus real Tailwind.
- CI's `Build & E2E` job runs `pnpm test:e2e --project=chromium` over `e2e/`, and a `sidebar.tsx` change triggers it.

The spec has six tests:

1. An expanded offcanvas sidebar sits inside the viewport, on either side.
2. An expanded offcanvas sidebar draws exactly as an expanded icon sidebar does: panel, gap, page edge, and the rail's box, translate, offset and hover line, on both sides.
3. A collapsed offcanvas sidebar sits wholly outside the viewport, and the page takes the full width.
4. The icon form is the control: 256px expanded, the 48px strip collapsed.
5. The `sidebar` node with `collapsible` omitted draws on-screen in a bare host.
6. `SidebarNav`'s offcanvas form is on-screen when expanded and off-screen when collapsed.

Declared fixtures, also stated in the spec header:

- `@object-ui/core` is a stub that records `register()`, so the node's component comes from its real registration.
- `@object-ui/react` and `@object-ui/i18n` are stubs. Neither is on the geometry path: the child list is empty here, and i18n is reached only through the mobile sheet's close label.
- `@object-ui/components`, as `SidebarNav` imports it, re-exports the same primitive files the barrel re-exports.

The workspace packages are stubbed because this lane builds no workspace `dist/`. That the real `SchemaRenderer` maps an omitted `collapsible` to `offcanvas` is already pinned through the real renderer by `sidebar-node-provider-10859.test.tsx`. The spec imports no workspace package by name, which is the premise `scripts/__tests__/e2e-type-check.test.ts` pins.

## Reverse verification (prediction written first, every leg from a committed state)

- **BASE leg** (HEAD `0ce9adf7c`). `sidebar.tsx` and `shadcn-local-patches.mjs` were swapped to their BASE blobs (`7eb315438` and `9c6218b6b`), and the new tests kept.
  - e2e: **4 failed / 2 passed**, as predicted. Tests 1, 2, 5 and 6 were red; 3 (collapsed) and 4 (icon control) were green.
  - `shadcn-local-patches.test.ts`: **2 failed / 51 passed**, as predicted: the new family-ids test and "no patch outside those three families".
  - Restored: both blobs equal HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is 0 bytes.
- **Six per-line ablations** through objectstack's `ablation-replace.mjs`. Each reverted one patched line in the shipped file to its registry anchor; the anchor hit 1 to 0, the blob moved, and the file was restored to blob `15cca6101` == HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`. Each leg landed exactly as predicted:
  - gap: e2e 3 failed (tests 2, 5, 6);
  - left offset: e2e 4 failed (1, 2, 5, 6);
  - right offset: e2e 2 failed (1, 2);
  - rail: e2e 1 failed (2);
  - rail left edge: e2e 1 failed (2);
  - rail right edge: e2e 1 failed (2);
  - in all six legs, the offline `sidebar.tsx carries its declared patches` went red (1 failed / 52 passed).
- **Declaration ablation.** The family was removed from `LOCAL_PATCHES.sidebar` and the shipped bytes kept. e2e: 6 passed (geometry reads the shipped bytes). The local-patches suite: 2 failed (family ids, three families). Restored to blob `bc7e528aa` == HEAD.

## Measured against the dispatch's mechanism assumptions

1. **Confirmed**, with the line positions shifted by objectui#11463: the attribute is set unconditionally, and the gap, the two offsets and the rail were unqualified. The rail also has two arbitrary-selector offcanvas rules (`-right-2` / `-left-2`) after the line triage named. They are the same defect on the same element, so they are in the family. Without them, an expanded offcanvas rail took `right: -8px` (measured above).
2. Instrument (a), for the reasons above.
3. The patch follows the existing family shape (`find` / `replace` / `marker` / `occurrences: 1`). The repo enforces the payload by marker containment (`verifyLocalPatches`, in the "shipped primitives still carry every declared patch" block). The markers are the whole replacement strings, and a new test asserts `marker === replace`, and that each replacement minus the qualifier is its anchor.
4. Note corrected. `shadcn-components.json` does not ship: `@object-ui/components`' `files` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` and `LICENSE`. So the changeset describes the behaviour, not the note.
5. `SidebarNav collapsible="offcanvas"` was **reached** at BASE (expanded -256 to 0). The same patch fixes it, and it is pinned (test 6). `SidebarNav.tsx` is not edited.
6. The collapsed offcanvas sidebar is still wholly off-screen (test 3).
   - Mobile, a one-off vitest render at `innerWidth` 375: the desktop `.group.peer` is not rendered, and the trigger opens the `[data-mobile="true"]` sheet.
   - Every hunk of the `sidebar.tsx` diff sits in the desktop return and in `SidebarRail`, none in the `isMobile` branch.

## Gates (final head `0e7b02c2d`)

- e2e spec (local runner: a scratch config without the console `webServer`, with `executablePath: '/opt/pw-browsers/chromium'`): `6 passed`.
- vitest, from the worktree root, through `os-verify-lock`. Three slices, 84 test files in total, all passed:
  - the 17 `scripts/__tests__` files that read the changed files or `e2e/`: `Test Files 17 passed (17)`, `Tests 427 passed (427)`;
  - components, layout, schema-catalog and reader tests: `Test Files 44 passed (44)`, `Tests 1178 passed (1178)`;
  - app-shell: `Test Files 23 passed (23)`, `Tests 406 passed (406)`.
  - The 84 files are every test naming `ui/sidebar`, `SidebarProvider`, `SidebarNav` or `collapsible` in components, layout, app-shell and schema-catalog, plus the readers of the changed files, plus both phase-2d pins.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` exit 0 (after building its dependency closure), `pnpm type-check:scripts` exit 0, `pnpm type-check:e2e` exit 0.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: `1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`.
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims`: 3 pending changesets name a touched file (`10859-sidebar-node-provider-collapsible`, `7397-remove-duplicate-chart-primitives`, `9569-components-stylesheet-source-none`). Each was read, and each is still true. None claims edit (3)'s "same result" or an offcanvas position, so no note was appended.
- Also exit 0:
  - `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:pre-install-import-graph`;
  - `check-test-path-roots`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `check-lint-coverage`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-no-major`;
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 6 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- ESLint, narrowed:
  - The population was read from ESLint's own config (`isPathIgnored` / `calculateConfigForFile`): all 4 changed lintable files are in it.
  - `eslint --format json` over those 4 files: 4 files, 0 errors, 2 warnings. Both warnings are `react-refresh/only-export-components` on the export block of `sidebar.tsx`, and the BASE blob carries the same 2.
  - No config object sets `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so the diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- **NOT MEASURED**, and why:
  - `pnpm shadcn:check`: `ui.shadcn.com` is not in this container's egress allowlist (44 of 44 fetches answered 403). The offline anchor suite covers the new anchors.
  - Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and full `pnpm test`: owned by CI.
  - The spec under the real `playwright.config.ts`: owned by CI's `Build & E2E` job.

## Acceptance notes

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` carries a dated snapshot comment ("Both readings are a SNAPSHOT") whose static complement says no `e2e/` spec except `record-header-title-width.spec.ts` names `node:fs`. This spec does too: it reads `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and Tailwind's own CSS. It opens no markdown, which is the fact that comment's reading is about. Not edited here: outside this card's file surface. carrier: none.
- `shadcn-components.json`'s sidebar note still does not mention the two earlier declared sidebar families (cookie read, optional context). This note is about the undeclared edits, so it is left as it is. carrier: none.
